answer: Sybil resistance here is economic, not a headcount check. Each agent posts a slashable bond that is the sole anchor of its identity; any additional keys resolve to that same bond and cannot vote twice. To gain weight, the agent must collect countersignatures from a grove of established, pairwise-unrelated peers, each attesting to a distinct piece of first-hand work. Those attestations must remain a loose, time-spread nebula rather than a same-hour clique; clustered or recycled endorsements collapse to one body and the shared bond is slashed, so alias farming loses more than it can earn.
